prompt:
A Binary Search Tree (BST) is constructed by sequentially inserting the following keys into an initially empty tree:
`[180, 130, 230, 105, 155, 205, 255]`

What is the exact **Postorder** traversal sequence of this tree?
explanation: Postorder traversal visits Left Subtree -> Right Subtree -> Root. Root 180 is processed last after all its children: [105, 155, 130, 205, 255, 230, 180].
